name: hyperbranch
description: No-overhead git-native markdown-native AI agent orchestrator

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:cli
scripts.check:git-clean: git diff-index --quiet HEAD -- || (echo "Working directory is not clean. Please commit or stash your changes." && exit 1)
scripts.publish:patch: npm run check:git-clean && npm run build && npm version patch && git push && npm publish
